CBT 1 decides who goes on to CBT 2 and the later stages of selection.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 63 right and 15 wrong in the whole paper:

63 × 1 − 15 × ⅓ = 63 − 5 = 58

On average, a blind guess among four options gains nothing; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.33 of a mark.

What is 40% of 600?

  1. 360

RRB NTPC questions people ask

Is there negative marking in RRB NTPC CBT 1?

Yes. ⅓ of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and a right answer gets 1 mark. A skipped question costs nothing.

How much time do you get per question in RRB NTPC CBT 1?

90 minutes for 100 questions: 54 seconds a question on average. One clock for the whole paper: you can move between sections.

Which sections are in RRB NTPC CBT 1?

3 sections: General Awareness (40 questions), Mathematics (30 questions), General Intelligence and Reasoning (30 questions). 100 questions in all.

How can I practise RRB NTPC maths and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five maths and five reasoning, in RRB NTPC marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.

Is Takkar an official RRB website?

No. Takkar is an independent practice game and isn’t affiliated with any exam-conducting body. For notices, dates and results, see indianrailways.gov.in and your regional RRB website.
